notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the recreation of the reference mesh. The revised render is the plug the D column's through hole takes: a tube as deep as the column, bored for the M2 bolt. The dimensions are in 210-003_IdlerPlug.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
